Frequently Asked Questions: What are the warning signs of periodontal disease? Bad breath or bad taste that won't go away, red or swollen gums, tender or bleeding gums, painful chewing, loose teeth, sensitive teeth, gums that have pulled away from your teeth, and any change in the way your teeth fit together when you bite are all warning signs. How can I keep my gums healthy? Ways to keep your gums healthy include brushing and flossing regularly, quitting smoking, reducing stress, eating a healthy diet, and getting regular dental check-ups. How can smoking affect my dental health? Smoking is an important cause of severe gum disease in the United States and can cause early gum disease, called gingivitis. Smoking can cause red or swollen gums, tender or bleeding gums, painful chewing, loose teeth, sensitive teeth, and gums that have pulled away from your teeth.

key_ingredients: Softovac Bowel Regulator Powder is used as a natural remedy for constipation, indigestion, and other digestive problems. It regulates bowel movements and activates the secretion of digestive juices to improve digestion. The powder helps to alleviate stomach discomfort and keeps the stomach healthy. It contains natural ingredients like isabgol, which is rich in fibre and is laxative in nature. It acts as a bowel regulator and helps absorb the bacteria and other harmful toxins in the intestine. The presence of sonamukhi helps facilitate bowel movement due to its anti-absorptive properties. It also has amaltas, whose laxative properties aid in the smooth evacuation of stools. It also contains harad and mulethi. While mulethi has healing properties that help prevent stomach or intestine-related ulcers or irritation, harad helps in properly functioning the intestine. The presence of saunf helps to avoid flatulence and to improve the symptoms of indigestion. Having gulab jal imparts demulcent properties to Softovac, which helps it form a protective layer in the intestine and aid in improving bowel movement.
